title: KoreLumina — Runtime + Preview - Korelumin Guardrail Enforcement

messages.content:
KORELUMINA COMMIT GUARDRAIL (ENFORCED)

SCOPE
- One module only
- No cross-module edits

PRE-COMMIT CHECK (ALL YES REQUIRED)
- build passes → yes
- preview renders → yes
- editor visible → yes
- filetree populated → yes
- save overwrites (no append) → yes
- diff visible → yes (if applicable)
- apply works → yes (if applicable)
- no console/runtime errors → yes

IF ANY “NO” → STOP

BRANCH RULES
- NEVER commit on main
- ALWAYS:

  git checkout main
  git pull origin main
  git checkout -b feature/<module>-<task>

COMMIT (ONLY VIA KPUSH)
- DO NOT use raw git push
- ALWAYS use:

  kpush "type(module): change"

PUSH FLOW (AUTOMATED BY KPUSH)
- merges latest main
- blocks on conflict
- commits + pushes safely

CONFLICT RULE
- NEVER rebase
- ALWAYS:

  git merge origin/main

- If conflict:
  KEEP LOCAL STABLE:

  git checkout --ours <file>
  git add .
  git commit -m "merge(main): keep stable local state"

- THEN:
  git push origin feature/<branch>

MERGE
- PR → GitHub merge only
- NO direct pushes to main

POST-MERGE
- git checkout main
- git pull origin main

PROHIBITED
- ❌ git push origin main
- ❌ git push --force main
- ❌ git pull --rebase
- ❌ editing conflicts manually line-by-line
- ❌ multi-module edits
- ❌ mixing UI + runtime + AI changes

AI RULE
- Small targeted edits only
- No full rewrites unless explicitly required
- No architecture changes

ROLLBACK
- Before risky change:

  git tag <module>-checkpoint
  git push origin <module>-checkpoint

- Restore:

  git checkout <tag>

Understood. Guardrail acknowledged and enforced.
Key constraints locked:


Single-module scope only


No commit if any pre-check fails


Feature branch workflow only (never main)


kpush exclusively for commits/push


No rebase; merge-only conflict handling with local state priority


No cross-module or architectural changes


Small, targeted edits only


Ready to proceed under these rules.
